items.title: swe-sim: a task from a fresh repository
items.note: Its hosted pipeline has run one task end to end, and that task came from an existing benchmark. Next it screens a task built from a fresh repository, with at least three trials in every cell, so a pass@3 can finally be reported.

items.title: saahil-brain: better pointers
items.note: On every prompt my agents get up to three pointers into the brain. On the eval closest to real use, the right file was among them for 11 of 69 prompts (15.9%) in the run of 13 October. A daily agent works on that number and keeps a change only if it goes up.

items.title: projectionist: the last two stages
items.note: Two jobs have not moved over from the old scripts yet: backing up Plex, and taking in new arrivals. Each becomes a Go stage, checked against the old script’s own output, and then the script is deleted.

items.title: DINOCell: the decoder
items.note: SAMCell’s method on Meta’s DINOv3 backbone. The decoder fails its first forward pass, because joining the skip connection doubles the channels and the next convolution expects half as many. That is the next fix.

items.title: travel-agent-gym: trips that can be finished
items.note: Version two is hard for the wrong reason. My scripted agent finishes only 8% of trips, and doing nothing scores better than booking. First I make trips finishable, then I make walking away the worst outcome.
